chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Lu never drinks before singing and learns lyrics in fifteen minutes
summary: Lu forgot lyrics once while drinking, so she stopped; she learns new songs quickly.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: I could never... Like, if I made a recording date, I never drank nothin'. Never... And even right now, if I'm working, I don't drink too much, and maybe I don't

drink nothing but water. Because one time I forgot the words. It's a good thing the piano player knew the words, because I was out. I came here to visit, and he asked me to do a number, and I got up to do this number... The tune doesn't come to me. And I forgot the words. And a good thing the piano player knew the words -- and he was telling me the words. So from that time on, I never got up to sing...I never drank when I had to sing.
That's a lot of lyrics to learn, though. I (?) a lot of singers who can remember all those different songs.

And those long songs, you know, they'd have the verse and then the chorus -- and it was so much things for me to learn. And it was very easy for me to learn all those words. They'd give me a new song, and Danny would say, "When you gonna (?) this?" I'd say, "I ain't ready yet." And he'd keep on, "When you..." -- and in fifteen minutes I could learn the tune, and I said, "Play it." And "Play it again." And the third time, you know, I got the music. And it wouldn't take me but fifteen minutes to learn the words and the music -- and a whole lot of words.
I have trouble with the Lord's Prayer.
